body.x: Blue Frog Robotics participated in “CES(Consumer Electronics Show) 2018 Unveiled” held on January 7, 2018 in Las Vegas, USA to introduce a pet robot equipped with various functions.

Founded in 2014, Blue Frog Robotics have developed robots in various fields including health care, national defense, etc. on the basis of its CEO’s various careers and experiences. Introduced this time, “Buddy” is a smart robot which performs various functions such as voice recognition, detection of persons’ faces or specific objects, photographing or filming, video calling, games, education, home security, smart home control, alarm, scheduler, etc.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
